items.q: This is Mezz and me putting our horns in our mouths.

ctx.x: at each other, couldn't say nothing, 'cause if you spoke French, you don't understand it, and you spoke English and he doesn't understand it. So, it was just one of those things. Well, at a quarter to ten, another officer came in and said, "Are you all set, you're ready?" We said, "Yes, we're ready." He said, "Take your positions as though you're going to play, ready to play. This is Mezz and me putting our horns in our mouths.
So, sitting here with your horn?
